description: Curated, experimental: Google Flights only (/travel/flights and one-way results /travel/flights/search?tfs=...). Per-day results by rewriting the date in tfs, a ?q= search from the search page instead of the date picker, pinned date arrows and result controls, status lines that are not loading.
notes: The Departure textbox opens a calendar dialog to pick a date; typing into it does nothing.
Each departure date has its own results page with a distinct URL, so another day is a different page from this one.
Next day and Previous day move the departure date by one day; the results update a few seconds later.
